decisive_spans.text: Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
Vascular channel endothelial cells were positive for CD34 and CD31

response.rationale: D2 is strongly supported by the histopathological findings of round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells and positive staining for CD34 and CD31. D1, epithelioid hemangioma, is also supported by the immunohistochemistry but lacks specific histopathological features mentioned in the vignette that are present in D2.
